name: @camstack/addon-export-hap
description: HomeKit (HAP) exporter for CamStack devices. Publishes each exposed device as its own HomeKit accessory: cameras and doorbells with SRTP streaming, HomeKit Secure Video, motion, two-way audio, PTZ and battery; switches, lights, locks and sensors through a capability→service table.

addons.name: HomeKit Export
addons.description: Publishes exposed CamStack devices to iOS Home over HomeKit (HAP) — cameras, doorbells, switches, lights, locks and sensors, each as its own accessory sharing one setup code.

storageLocations.description: Copies of the clips CamStack SENT to HomeKit Secure Video. HomeKit is a sink — HAP has no read-back — so a clip is only ever ours if we teed it while sending it. Its own location because a teed clip has no track, detection or event behind it, so it is not event media and no media-class retention may attach to it: the age is per camera (14 days by default) with fixed per-camera and whole-store rails. Exactly ONE location; repoint it to choose the disk. Written under the `homekit-clips/` subtree so occupancy is the class subtree even when it shares a root.
